_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Ultimate Weapon#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Dodegar Bandysnoot と話す。

The Ultimate Weapon#001.src: I'm glad you came along, I could do with a little help if you're not too busy.
The Ultimate Weapon#001.dst: 来てくれてよかった、忙しくなければちょっと手伝ってほしいんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#001.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#002.src: I'm Dodegar Bandysnoot, the world famous Hobbit swordsmith! Perhaps you've heard of me?
The Ultimate Weapon#002.dst: 僕は Dodegar Bandysnoot、世界的に有名なホビットの刀鍛冶さ！聞いたことあるかな？
The Ultimate Weapon#002.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#003.src: No? Oh... Well, I've had an idea about how I could make the best weapon that the world has ever seen!
The Ultimate Weapon#003.dst: ない？そう…まあいいや、世界一の武器を作る方法を思いついたんだ！
The Ultimate Weapon#003.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#004.src: But, I need some help getting the special resources to make it.
The Ultimate Weapon#004.dst: でも、作るための特別な材料集めを手伝ってほしいんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#004.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#005.src: You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
The Ultimate Weapon#005.dst: 手伝ってくれる？！やった！二人分作れるだけの材料を集めよう！
The Ultimate Weapon#005.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#006.src: So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#006.dst: まず、柄にする生きた木が要る。[{~} Enchanted Stick] あれば足りるはず。
The Ultimate Weapon#006.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#007.src: The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
The Ultimate Weapon#007.dst: 西の川向こう、大きな木の幹にいる木の精には魔力があるんだ！それで柄が使い手の手に馴染むってわけ！一本くらいならすぐ手に入るはずさ！
The Ultimate Weapon#007.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#008.src: I hope you are prepared, this will be your best quest yet!
The Ultimate Weapon#008.dst: 準備はいい？これまでで最高のクエストになるよ！
The Ultimate Weapon#008.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#009.src: Collect [{~} Enchanted Stick] from Wood Sprites at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return them to Dodegar
The Ultimate Weapon#009.dst: [{~} Enchanted Stick] を木の精 ([-{~}, {~}, -{~}]) から集め、Dodegar に届ける

The Ultimate Weapon#010.src: Wow! You got the wood I needed, thanks!
The Ultimate Weapon#010.dst: わあ！欲しかった木だ、ありがとう！
The Ultimate Weapon#010.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#011.src: While I'm making the handle, could you help me with the blade?
The Ultimate Weapon#011.dst: 僕が柄を作ってる間に、刃の方を手伝ってくれる？
The Ultimate Weapon#011.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#012.src: Since we want this weapon to be as good as possible we need to find some sacred Hobbit metal!
The Ultimate Weapon#012.dst: 最高の武器にしたいから、神聖なホビットの金属を見つけなきゃ！
The Ultimate Weapon#012.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#013.src: The hobbit village, The Shiar, is really close! Follow the southern road. My brother Gogedar should be there!
The Ultimate Weapon#013.dst: ホビットの村 The Shiar はすぐ近くだよ！南の道を行って。弟の Gogedar がいるはず！
The Ultimate Weapon#013.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#014.src: Dodegar needs [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] from the Shiar at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Ultimate Weapon#014.dst: Dodegar には [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] が必要。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の The Shiar で手に入れる

The Ultimate Weapon#015.src: My brother you say... Trying to create a weapon...
The Ultimate Weapon#015.dst: 兄貴がって…武器を作ろうとしてる…？
The Ultimate Weapon#015.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#017.src: Oh he needs Sacred Hobbit Metal!?
The Ultimate Weapon#017.dst: えっ、神聖なホビットの金属が要るって！？
The Ultimate Weapon#017.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#019.src: Sorry can't help you. I don't really know what that is.
The Ultimate Weapon#019.dst: 悪いけど力になれない。それが何なのかよく知らないんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#019.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#020.dst: いとこの Togedar に聞いてみたら？
The Ultimate Weapon#020.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#021.dst: The Shiar で Togedar を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#022.src: Dodegar? Does not really ring a bell I'm afraid.
The Ultimate Weapon#022.dst: Dodegar？悪いけど、ピンと来ないね。
The Ultimate Weapon#022.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#023.src: Oh! Gogedar's brother, why didn't you tell me that.
The Ultimate Weapon#023.dst: ああ！Gogedar の兄さんか、それを先に言ってよ。
The Ultimate Weapon#023.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#024.src: Sacred Hobbit Metal... This is a metal forged by master blacksmith hobbits within our village. It is a bit expensive to get by but holds great potential, if used properly.
The Ultimate Weapon#024.dst: 神聖なホビットの金属…村の名匠ホビットたちが鍛えた金属さ。手に入れるには少々高いが、うまく使えば大きな可能性を秘めている。
The Ultimate Weapon#024.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#025.dst: おや。一つ欲しいのかい？
The Ultimate Weapon#025.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#026.src: I don't have any. Maybe ask my nephew's brother Alegdar?
The Ultimate Weapon#026.dst: 持ってないよ。おいっ子の兄貴の Alegdar に聞いてみたら？
The Ultimate Weapon#026.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#027.dst: The Shiar で Alegdar を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#029.src: I actually don't know much about... anything.
The Ultimate Weapon#029.dst: 実は僕、何も…よく知らないんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#029.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#030.src: I kind of just... stand around here.
The Ultimate Weapon#030.dst: ただ…ここに立ってるだけっていうか。
The Ultimate Weapon#030.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#031.src: Everyone I have ever met just calls me annoying and useless. So I decided to stop trying.
The Ultimate Weapon#031.dst: 会う人みんなに、うざくて役立たずって言われる。だから頑張るのはやめたんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#031.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#032.src: You know, life is hard. We all just have to fight through, and then eventually, we might become happy.
The Ultimate Weapon#032.dst: 人生ってつらいよね。みんな耐えて戦うしかない、そしたらいつか幸せになれるかも。
The Ultimate Weapon#032.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#033.src: Right sorry... Ask Balegar for any information. He is way smarter.
The Ultimate Weapon#033.dst: あ、ごめん…話なら Balegar に聞いて。彼の方がずっと賢いから。
The Ultimate Weapon#033.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#034.dst: The Shiar で Balegar を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#035.src: My cousin's nephew's dad has had a rough year... I feel bad for him.
The Ultimate Weapon#035.dst: いとこのおいっ子の親父が散々な一年でさ…気の毒だよ。
The Ultimate Weapon#035.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#037.src: I have nooooo clue about that metal. I heard it was just a valuable as a normal rock.
The Ultimate Weapon#037.dst: その金属のことはさーっぱり分からん。ただの石と同じくらいの値打ちだって聞いたけど。
The Ultimate Weapon#037.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#038.src: Maybe my cousin Reyoretrsed knows anything about it.
The Ultimate Weapon#038.dst: いとこの Reyoretrsed なら何か知ってるかも。
The Ultimate Weapon#038.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#039.dst: The Shiar で Reyoretrsed を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#041.src: You are wondering how my name is pronounced? What a rude question.
The Ultimate Weapon#041.dst: 私の名前の読み方が知りたい？なんと失礼な質問だ。
The Ultimate Weapon#041.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#042.src: Ray-ore-tree-sed, obviously. What is a human doing here?
The Ultimate Weapon#042.dst: レイ・オア・ツリー・セッド、当然だろう。人間がここで何をしている？
The Ultimate Weapon#042.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#043.src: You are wondering if I have Sacred whatever metal?
The Ultimate Weapon#043.dst: 神聖な何とかの金属を持っているかって？
The Ultimate Weapon#043.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#044.src: I'm {~}. Now if you excuse me, I am busy standing still. Go bother Richard or something.
The Ultimate Weapon#044.dst: 私は {~}。さて失礼、じっと立っているので忙しいのだ。Richard にでも絡んでくれ。
The Ultimate Weapon#044.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#045.dst: The Shiar で Richard を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#046.src: I've been trying to tell you that I have what you need.
The Ultimate Weapon#046.dst: 必要な物はここにあるって、ずっと言おうとしてたんだけど。
The Ultimate Weapon#046.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#047.src: You humans really need to practice your communication skills, please.
The Ultimate Weapon#047.dst: 人間ってのは、本当に会話の練習をした方がいいよ。
The Ultimate Weapon#047.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#048.src: Anyway, here. Take it! This metal is just a scam anyway, nothing special with it.
The Ultimate Weapon#048.dst: とにかく、ほら。持っていきな！どうせこの金属はただのインチキで、特別なところなんてないさ。
The Ultimate Weapon#048.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#049.src: Return to Dodegar with the metal.
The Ultimate Weapon#049.dst: 金属を持って Dodegar の所へ戻る。

The Ultimate Weapon#050.src: I hope it wasn't too much of an issue to get!
The Ultimate Weapon#050.dst: 手に入れるの、そんなに大変じゃなかったならいいけど！
The Ultimate Weapon#050.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#051.src: ... I forgot a step. I can't attach a blade without a binder material.
The Ultimate Weapon#051.dst: …工程を一つ忘れてた。接着剤がないと刃が付けられない。
The Ultimate Weapon#051.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#052.src: I need the nectar of a native flower of the forest to attach it. [{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] would do the trick.
The Ultimate Weapon#052.dst: 取り付けるには森の固有種の花の蜜が要るんだ。[{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] があればいける。
The Ultimate Weapon#052.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#053.src: Finding the flower can be rather difficult, here's a riddle on how to find it.
The Ultimate Weapon#053.dst: その花を見つけるのはちょっと難しいから、探し方のなぞなぞを出すね。
The Ultimate Weapon#053.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#054.src: On the side of a hut, hidden inside a hole. Resting in a forest of light, without plight. Whatever that would mean.
The Ultimate Weapon#054.dst: 小屋の脇、穴の中に隠れ。光の森に憂いなく眠る。どういう意味か知らないけど。
The Ultimate Weapon#054.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#055.src: Find the Diplacus Aurantiacus by following the riddle to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Ultimate Weapon#055.dst: なぞなぞを頼りに [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Diplacus Aurantiacus を見つける。

The Ultimate Weapon#056.src: Hold up! This feels waaay, toooo easy.
The Ultimate Weapon#056.dst: 待った！簡単すぎーーーる！
The Ultimate Weapon#056.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#057.src: If I'm going to give you this amazingly, incredible, showstopping, crazy item particulary for free, you need to at least work for it!
The Ultimate Weapon#057.dst: この驚異的で信じられないほど最高にぶっ飛んだ品を「タダ」であげるんだから、せめて苦労くらいはしてもらわないと！
The Ultimate Weapon#057.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#060.src: This looks so much better! Anyway, bring me that flower now!
The Ultimate Weapon#060.dst: こっちの方がずっといい！とにかく、あの花を持ってきて！
The Ultimate Weapon#060.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#061.src: Talk to Dodegar with the Diplacus Aurantiacus.
The Ultimate Weapon#061.dst: Diplacus Aurantiacus を持って Dodegar と話す。

The Ultimate Weapon#062.src: Took you a while, did it not?
The Ultimate Weapon#062.dst: ずいぶん時間がかかったね？
The Ultimate Weapon#062.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#063.src: It's starting to look pretty amazing! Just like it's supposed to I'm sure!
The Ultimate Weapon#063.dst: すごくいい感じになってきた！きっとこれで合ってるはず！
The Ultimate Weapon#063.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#064.src: Maybe this will actually work out. Either way, last ingredient we need!
The Ultimate Weapon#064.dst: 本当にうまくいくかも。何にせよ、あと最後の材料だ！
The Ultimate Weapon#064.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#065.src: So to finalize and apply some magical properties to this uniquely amazing item we need something known as Luster Blood.
The Ultimate Weapon#065.dst: この唯一無二の傑作を仕上げて魔力を宿すには、「輝きの血」と呼ばれるものが必要なんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#065.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#066.src: The only known creature in the west, probably in the whole world, if I'm being frank, is known as the Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld, not sure where the name comes from.
The Ultimate Weapon#066.dst: 西で、正直に言えば世界中でも、それを持つと知られる唯一の生き物は Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld。名前の由来は知らない。
The Ultimate Weapon#066.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#067.src: I happen to know that this beetle lives in a cave in the eastern ravine thingy! If you walk straight east, you should stumble upon it, I promise!
The Ultimate Weapon#067.dst: その甲虫は東の峡谷みたいな所の洞窟に住んでるって知ってるんだ！まっすぐ東へ歩けば出くわすはず、約束するよ！
The Ultimate Weapon#067.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#068.src: Oh! Almost forgot to mention, about {~} Luster Blood is probably enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#068.dst: あ！言い忘れてた、輝きの血は {~} 個くらいあれば足りると思う。
The Ultimate Weapon#068.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#069.src: Find the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Luster Blood] and bring it back to Dodegar.
The Ultimate Weapon#069.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟を見つけ、[{~} Luster Blood] を Dodegar に持ち帰る。

The Ultimate Weapon#070.src: Do not step any closer... Or I will be forced to obliterate you!
The Ultimate Weapon#070.dst: それ以上近づくな…さもなくば消し去るぞ！

The Ultimate Weapon#071.src: The final component! It is finally here!
The Ultimate Weapon#071.dst: 最後の部品！ついに揃った！
The Ultimate Weapon#071.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#073.src: Do you see how it's glowing, sparkling and... and radiating!
The Ultimate Weapon#073.dst: 見て、光って、きらめいて…輝きを放ってる！
The Ultimate Weapon#073.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#074.src: You don't? Uhm... maybe you need glasses humie.
The Ultimate Weapon#074.dst: 見えない？えっと…メガネが要るんじゃない、人間くん。
The Ultimate Weapon#074.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#075.src: As promised! Here you go! Always happy to practice the art of weapon creation.
The Ultimate Weapon#075.dst: 約束通り！はいどうぞ！武器作りの腕を磨けるのはいつでも大歓迎さ。
The Ultimate Weapon#075.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.src: The metal is rather rare so I don't know if you can even find it...
The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.dst: その金属はかなり珍しいから、見つけられるかどうか…
